critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx toggleTheme uses fire-and-forget api.put('/auth/theme') with .catch(()=>{}) — good, but a transient network failure silently leaves account state out of sync with UI/localStorage. Consider surfacing a small toast on error and/or verifying next /auth/me on failure. Non-blocking.

AuthContext.jsx theme effect runs only when user.theme changes; if user logs in on a device where localStorage has 'dark' but account theme='light', the flash-of-dark before /auth/me resolves might occur. Current App.js pre-hydration handles the initial paint (light default); acceptable trade-off.

plans_cotes.py cotes_check_all runs all pages in asyncio.gather — for a plan with many pages this may hit Gemini rate limits or timeouts. Consider a semaphore (e.g. max 3 parallel) or sequential fallback when len(pages)>3. Minor perf/reliability.
